nodes.long_description: Consegues salvar o teu pet? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet desafia a tua criatividade em VR. Usa os comandos para desenhar escudos que reagem à física. Resiste 10 segundos para ganhar! Dezenas de níveis desafiantes e visuais fofos num ambiente 3D vibrante. As abelhas estão a chegar!
nodes.short_description: Desenha para salvar! Protege o teu animal de estimação de abelhas furiosas desenhando barreiras em 3D.

nodes.long_description: Czy uratujesz zwierzaka? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet to wciągająca gra logiczna VR. Użyj kontrolerów, aby rysować tarcze reagujące na fizykę. Wytrzymaj 10 sekund, aby wygrać! Czekają na Ciebie dziesiątki poziomów i urocza grafika 3D. Pszczoły nadlatują, chwyć wirtualne pióro!
nodes.short_description: Rysuj, aby ratować! Chroń swojego zwierzaka przed rojem pszczół, rysując bariery ochronne w przestrzeni 3D.

nodes.long_description: 你能從蜂群中救出寵物嗎？走進 Meta Horizon 上最令人著迷的繪畫益智遊戲！使用 VR 控制器作為魔法筆，繪製符合物理定律的防禦盾牌。堅守 10 秒即獲勝！體驗數十個燒腦關卡、可愛的視覺效果和充滿樂趣的物理挑戰。蜂群即將來襲，快拿起畫筆！
nodes.short_description: 畫線營救！在《Angry Bee - Protect My Pet》中，透過在 3D 空間繪製屏障，保護你的寵物免受蜂群攻擊。

nodes.long_description: Poți salva animalul de companie? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet îți provoacă creativitatea în VR. Folosește controllerele pentru a desena scuturi care respectă legile fizicii. Rezistă 10 secunde pentru a câștiga! Te așteaptă zeci de nivele captivante și personaje drăguțe într-un mediu 3D.
nodes.short_description: Desenează pentru a salva! Protejează-ți animalul de un roi de albine furioase desenând bariere în spațiul 3D.

nodes.long_description: 你能从蜂群中救出宠物吗？走进 Meta Horizon 上最令人着迷的绘画益智游戏！使用 VR 控制器作为魔法笔，绘制符合物理定律的防御盾牌。坚守 10 秒即获胜！体验数十个烧脑关卡、可爱的视觉效果和充满乐趣的物理挑战。蜂群即将来袭，快拿起画笔！
nodes.short_description: 画线营救！在《Angry Bee - Protect My Pet》中，通过在 3D 空间绘制屏障，保护你的宠物免受蜂群攻击。

nodes.long_description: Riuscirai a salvare il tuo animale? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet sfida la tua creatività in VR. Usa i controller per disegnare scudi che reagiscono alla fisica. Resisti 10 secondi per vincere! Decine di livelli stimolanti e grafica 3D immersiva. Le api arrivano, prendi la tua penna virtuale!
nodes.short_description: Disegna per salvare! Proteggi il tuo animale da uno sciame di api inferocite disegnando barriere in 3D.

nodes.long_description: 你能從蜂群中救出寵物嗎？走進 Meta Horizon 上最令人著迷的繪畫益智遊戲！使用 VR 控制器作為魔法筆，繪製符合物理定律的防禦盾牌。堅守 10 秒即獲勝！體驗數十個燒腦關卡、可愛的視覺效果和充滿樂趣的物理挑戰。蜂群即將來襲，快拿起畫筆！
nodes.short_description: 畫線營救！在《Angry Bee - Protect My Pet》中，透過在 3D 空間繪製屏障，保護你的寵物免受蜂群攻擊。

nodes.long_description: ミツバチの攻撃からペットを救えるか？『Angry Bee - Protect My Pet』は、VRの世界であなたの創造性と反射神経を試すパズルゲームです。VRコントローラーを魔法のペンにして、物理演算に反応するラインを描きましょう。10秒間守りきればクリア！かわいいビジュアルと物理ベースのパズルがあなたを待っています。
nodes.short_description: 描いて守れ！3D空間に保護壁を描き、怒ったミツバチの群れから愛らしいペットを救い出しましょう。

nodes.long_description: Kan du redde kæledyret? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet udfordrer din kreativitet i VR. Brug dine VR-controllere til at tegne skjolde, der reagerer på fysik. Hold ud i 10 sekunder for at vinde! Oplev sjove fysik-baserede gåder og søde karakterer i et levende 3D-miljø.
nodes.short_description: Tegn for at redde! Beskyt dit kæledyr mod en sværm af vrede bier ved at tegne beskyttende barrierer i 3D.

nodes.long_description: ¿Puedes salvar a tu mascota? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet desafía tu creatividad en VR. Usa tus controles como un lápiz mágico para dibujar escudos que reaccionan a la física. ¡Resiste 10 segundos para ganar! Decenas de niveles y visuales tiernos en un entorno 3D vibrante. ¡Ya vienen las abejas!
nodes.short_description: ¡Dibuja para salvar! Protege a tu mascota de un enjambre de abejas furiosas dibujando barreras en 3D.

nodes.long_description: Сможешь спасти питомца? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet — это захватывающая VR-головоломка. Рисуйте щиты, которые реагируют на физику. Продержитесь 10 секунд, чтобы победить! Вас ждут десятки уровней и милые персонажи в ярком 3D-мире. Пчелы близко, бери виртуальную ручку!
nodes.short_description: Рисуй, чтобы спасти! Защити своего питомца от роя рассерженных пчел, рисуя защитные барьеры в 3D.

nodes.long_description: Μπορείτε να σώσετε το κατοικίδιο; Το Angry Bee – Protect My Pet προκαλεί τη δημιουργικότητά σας στο VR. Σχεδιάστε ασπίδες που αντιδρούν στη φυσική. Αντέξτε 10 δευτερόλεπτα για να κερδίσετε! Δεκάδες επίπεδα, χαριτωμένοι χαρακτήρες και διασκέδαση βασισμένη στη φυσική σας περιμένουν.
nodes.short_description: Σχεδιάστε για να σώσετε! Προστατέψτε το κατοικίδιό σας από οργισμένες μέλισσες σχεδιάζοντας εμπόδια σε 3D.

nodes.long_description: Voitko pelastaa lemmikkisi? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet haastaa luovuutesi VR:ssä. Käytä ohjaimia piirtääksesi suojia, jotka tottelevat fysiikkaa. Kestä 10 sekuntia voittaaksesi! Tarjolla on kymmeniä tasoja, suloisia hahmoja ja aivoja kutkuttavia fysiikkapulmia.
nodes.short_description: Piirrä pelastaaksesi! Suojaa lemmikkisi vihaiselta mehiläisparvelta piirtämällä esteitä 3D-tilassa.

nodes.long_description: Zachráníte mazlíčka před rojem? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet vyzývá vaši kreativitu ve VR. Kreslete čáry a štíty, které reagují na fyziku. Vydržte 10 sekund a vyhrajte! Čekají vás desítky úrovní, roztomilá grafika a fyzikální hádanky. Včely útočí, připravte si virtuální pero!
nodes.short_description: Kreslete, abyste zachránili! Chraňte svého mazlíčka před rojem rozzuřených včel kreslením bariér ve 3D prostoru.

nodes.long_description: Kan du rädda husdjuret? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet utmanar din kreativitet i VR. Använd dina kontroller för att rita sköldar som reagerar på fysik. Håll ut i 10 sekunder för att vinna nivån! Upplev kluriga pussel och söta karaktärer i en färgstark 3D-miljö.
nodes.short_description: Rita för att rädda! Skydda ditt husdjur från en svärm av arga bin genom att rita skyddsbarriärer i 3D.

nodes.long_description: ¿Puedes salvar a tu mascota? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet desafía tu creatividad en VR. Usa tus controles como un lápiz mágico para dibujar escudos que reaccionan a la física. ¡Resiste 10 segundos para ganar! Decenas de niveles y visuales tiernos en un entorno 3D vibrante. ¡Ya vienen las abejas!
nodes.short_description: ¡Dibuja para salvar! Protege a tu mascota de un enjambre de abejas furiosas dibujando barreras en 3D.

nodes.long_description: Can You Save the Pet from the Angry Swarm? Step into the most addictive drawing puzzle on Meta Horizon! Use your VR controllers to draw protective barriers in 3D. Every shape reacts to real physics. Survive the attack for 10 seconds to win! Featuring brain-teasing levels and immersive 3D visuals.
nodes.short_description: Draw to save! In Angry Bee - Protect My Pet, your mission is to shield your adorable pet from a swarm of angry bees.

nodes.long_description: Bạn có thể cứu thú cưng không? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet thử thách sự sáng tạo của bạn trong VR. Sử dụng bộ điều khiển để vẽ các tấm khiên phản ứng với vật lý. Giữ vững phòng thủ trong 10 giây để chiến thắng! Trải nghiệm hàng chục cấp độ hack não và hình ảnh 3D sống động. Đàn ong đang đến!
nodes.short_description: Vẽ để giải cứu! Bảo vệ thú cưng của bạn khỏi đàn ong giận dữ bằng cách vẽ các rào chắn bảo vệ trong không gian 3D.

nodes.long_description:
Can You Save the Pet from the Angry Swarm?

Step into the most addictive drawing puzzle on Meta Horizon! Angry Bee - Protect My Pet challenges your creativity and reflexes in a fully immersive VR world. Your poor pet is in trouble—a hive of angry bees is on the attack, and only your quick thinking (and drawing!) can save the day.

Why You Will Love It:

Creative Drawing Mechanics: Use your VR controllers as a magic pencil to draw lines, walls, and shields in 3D. Every shape you draw reacts to real physics!

Intense Bee Attacks: Watch as the swarm tries to find any gap in your defense. You must hold your shield for 10 seconds to win the level!

Dozens of Brain-Teasing Levels: From simple flat ground to complex floating platforms, every level requires a new strategy to keep the bees away.

Cute & Immersive Visuals: Experience the charm of your pet and the buzz of the bees in a vibrant, high-contrast 3D environment.

Physics-Based Fun: Experiment with different shapes. Sometimes a circle works, but sometimes you need a complex cage to survive the sting!

The bees are coming! Grab your virtual pen, draw your defense, and become the ultimate protector.
nodes.short_description: Draw to save! In Angry Bee - Protect My Pet, your mission is to shield your adorable pet from a swarm of angry bees. Use your VR controllers to draw protective barriers in a 3D space. One wrong line and the bees will get through! With challenging physics-based puzzles and cute characters, can you survive the sting and keep your pet safe?

nodes.long_description: Pouvez-vous sauver votre animal ? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet met votre créativité à l'épreuve en VR. Dessinez des boucliers qui réagissent à la physique. Tenez 10 secondes pour gagner ! Découvrez des niveaux stimulants et des graphismes immersifs. Les abeilles arrivent, préparez votre stylo virtuel !
nodes.short_description: Dessinez pour sauver ! Protégez votre animal d'un essaim d'abeilles en colère en traçant des barrières en 3D.

nodes.long_description: Evcil hayvanını kurtarabilir misin? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet, VR'da yaratıcılığını test ediyor. Fizik kurallarına tepki veren kalkanlar çizmek için VR kollarını kullan. Kazanmak için 10 saniye dayan! Onlarca zeka geliştirici seviye ve sevimli karakterler seni bekliyor. Arılar geliyor, kalemine sarıl!
nodes.short_description: Kurtarmak için çiz! 3D alanda koruyucu bariyerler çizerek evcil hayvanını kızgın arı sürüsünden koru.

nodes.long_description: Kun jij het huisdier redden? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet daagt je creativiteit uit in VR. Gebruik je VR-controllers als magisch potlood om schilden te tekenen. Houd je verdediging 10 seconden vol om te winnen! Geniet van uitdagende levels en schattige visuals in een meeslepende omgeving.
nodes.short_description: Teken om te redden! Bescherm je huisdier tegen een zwerm boze bijen door barrières te tekenen in een 3D-ruimte.

nodes.long_description: Kan du redde kjæledyret? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet utfordrer din kreativitet i VR. Bruk kontrollerne som en magisk blyant for å tegne skjold. Hold ut i 10 sekunder for å vinne nivået! Opplev morsomme fysikkpuslespill og søte karakterer i et levende 3D-miljø.
nodes.short_description: Tegn for å redde! Beskytt kjæledyret ditt mot en sverm av sinte bier ved å tegne barrierer i 3D-rommet.

nodes.long_description: Você consegue salvar seu pet? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet desafia sua criatividade em VR. Use os controles para desenhar escudos que reagem à física. Aguente 10 segundos para vencer! Dezenas de níveis desafiadores e visuais fofos em um ambiente 3D vibrante. As abelhas estão chegando!
nodes.short_description: Desenhe para salvar! Proteja seu animal de estimação de um enxame de abelhas desenhando barreiras em 3D.

nodes.long_description: 벌떼로부터 반려동물을 구할 수 있을까요? VR 세계에서 창의력을 발휘해 보세요. VR 컨트롤러로 물리 법칙이 적용되는 방어선을 그리세요. 10초 동안 벌의 공격을 막아내면 승리! 수십 개의 흥미진진한 레벨과 귀여운 캐릭터들이 가득한 몰입형 3D 환경을 경험해 보세요.
nodes.short_description: 그려서 구하세요! 3D 공간에 보호막을 그려 성난 벌떼로부터 귀여운 반려동물을 보호하는 미션입니다.

nodes.long_description: Können Sie das Haustier retten? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet fordert Ihre Kreativität in VR heraus. Nutzen Sie Ihre VR-Controller, um Schutzwälle zu zeichnen. Halten Sie 10 Sekunden lang stand, um zu gewinnen! Genießen Sie physikbasierte Rätsel und süße Charaktere in einer lebendigen 3D-Welt.
nodes.short_description: Zeichnen zum Retten! Schützen Sie Ihr Haustier vor wütenden Bienen, indem Sie Barrieren im 3D-Raum zeichnen.

nodes.long_description: Consegues salvar o teu pet? Angry Bee – Protect My Pet desafia a tua criatividade em VR. Usa os comandos para desenhar escudos que reagem à física. nodes.long_description:
Can You Save the Pet from the Angry Swarm?

Step into the most addictive drawing puzzle on Meta Horizon! Angry Bee - Protect My Pet challenges your creativity and reflexes in a fully immersive VR world. Your poor pet is in trouble—a hive of angry bees is on the attack, and only your quick thinking (and drawing!) can save the day.

Why You Will Love It:

Creative Drawing Mechanics: Use your VR controllers as a magic pencil to draw lines, walls, and shields in 3D. Every shape you draw reacts to real physics!

Intense Bee Attacks: Watch as the swarm tries to find any gap in your defense. You must hold your shield for 10 seconds to win the level!

Dozens of Brain-Teasing Levels: From simple flat ground to complex floating platforms, every level requires a new strategy to keep the bees away.

Cute & Immersive Visuals: Experience the charm of your pet and the buzz of the bees in a vibrant, high-contrast 3D environment.

Physics-Based Fun: Experiment with different shapes. Sometimes a circle works, but sometimes you need a complex cage to survive the sting!

The bees are coming! Grab your virtual pen, draw your defense, and become the ultimate protector.
nodes.short_description: Draw to save! In Angry Bee - Protect My Pet, your mission is to shield your adorable pet from a swarm of angry bees. Use your VR controllers to draw protective barriers in a 3D space. One wrong line and the bees will get through! With challenging physics-based puzzles and cute characters, can you survive the sting and keep your pet safe?
